schema_hint: unregistered; proposed basket.macro_register@1. B00 owns schemas/**; registration is not requested by this change.
purpose: Static register of the macro measures tracked to characterize the market backdrop against which live tape is read. It names what is tracked, how each is computed, which candidate contrast it routes to, where it comes from, whether access is verified, and when a reading expires. It holds no dated observations.
doctrine: Measure the backdrop; do not forecast. No probabilities, forecasts or trade instructions appear in this register.
Index and aggregate level only. Ticker specifics belong to ticker research.
Output is per-contrast direction and magnitude. Concurrent or disagreeing contrasts are valid states, not defects.
Static register only. Dated observations belong in snapshots (append-only; corrections are new files), never in this file.
Unretrieved or unentitled measures stay unknown. Never infer one from another series.

Thresholds are hypotheses until validated. Fixed reference points from the 2026-09-30 instrument (COR1M 15, DSPX 25, MOVE/VIX 5) were shown to stamp the era rather than the day and are not carried forward.
Every figure carries data age and a TTD. Expired observations are historical evidence only.
USD. Original currency and dated FX basis would be preserved for any non-USD series; none is tracked at v1.0.0.

partition.logic: Register = what is tracked and how it is read (static, versioned). Snapshot = what was observed at a time (dated, append-only). Method prompt = how an analysis is run (kept at the Claude Project level as claude/macro-backdrop-template.md).
partition.naming: macros.v<MAJOR>.json. A change to the meaning of an existing field creates macros.v<MAJOR+1>.json. Additive measures bump MINOR in the version field. Measure ids are stable: C=contrast, I=intraday, F=futures, IX=index close, R=rates and policy, E=energy, D=dollar, V=volatility.

access_status_vocabulary.verified: Retrieved from an entitled or official source on evidence_date.
access_status_vocabulary.cross_checked: Retrieved from two or more independent web sources that agree; no entitled or official source.
access_status_vocabulary.unverified: Single web source, missing timestamp, or conflicting sources.
access_status_vocabulary.not_entitled: Provider refused the series on evidence_date.
access_status_vocabulary.failed_fetch: Source page failed to load on evidence_date.

ratio_z21.level: v = close(numerator) / close(denominator), daily adjusted closes
ratio_z21.a21: mean of v over 21 sessions including the current session
ratio_z21.sigma: sqrt(mean(r^2)) where r is the daily ratio return, over the trailing 30 calendar days
ratio_z21.note: Level against a trailing average is a regime read. No deadband width is set; see unknowns.

intraday_vs_prior_close.expiry: Levels expire at their session's close.
intraday_vs_prior_close.thin_volume_rule: Flag any 1-minute bar whose volume is small relative to the instrument's regular-session volume. No numeric cutoff is set; see unknowns.
intraday_vs_prior_close.time: Provider timestamps are UTC milliseconds. ET display is UTC-5 from 2026-11-01 (DST ended) and UTC-4 before.

level_vs_threshold.rule: Compare the current level with each attached threshold. A threshold is a hypothesis, carries its set date and rationale, and is not a forecast.

event.rule: A scheduled event carries its date, time in ET, source class and access status. Consensus and prior values are quoted as published and are not predictions made here.

routing.rule: A candidate is judged against its routed contrast since the prior close, not against the index. Rising with the tape does not count.

states.description: Index holds its premarket gain but C03 is still sagging. Confirm only candidates beating their routed contrast.

any_of.description: Index gives back its premarket gain and C03 and C04 make new lows.

states.description: Incoherence flag: C01 falling while C03 also falls means broad liquidation. The rotation reading is void and the instrument reports no state for candidates.

permission_rules.caveat: Descriptive classification of the backdrop only. It is not a forecast and gives no trade instruction.

base_rate_study.episode_rule: Events within 10 sessions of the first event in a cluster count as one episode.
base_rate_study.caveat: Small sample. Descriptive hit counts only; not a probability and not a forecast.
